name: qfn-ep
title: QFN package with exposed pad
summary: QFN package with exposed pad: a sawn moulding with square sides, its copper terminals bare at the cut and plated with matte tin underneath; terminals on all four sides, a centred exposed pad; a laser-marked pin-1 dot; a marking-top surface on the top face (terminals, terminals_short, pitch, body_length, body_width, body_height, terminal_length, terminal_width, pullback, frame, plating, edge_round, mark_radius, mark_depth, pad_length, pad_width).
provenance: Original work, saved through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored`; the no-lead generator gives every parameter its value. Construction after TI's RGV0016A (4219037/A) and DML0010A (4222524/A) outlines (sawn, pin-1 index area, no moulded dimple) and Sensirion's SHT4x datasheet v7.3 §5 (side walls bare copper); leadframe and plating thickness, edge round and dot size are estimated. Looked at, never copied: the manufacturers' photographs and package drawings cited; no vendor drawing, CAD model or EDA library data copied.
